artifact.title: EVM multi-chain read partial failure (base RPC)
artifact.body: This turn's evm_status call returned clean zero balances for ethereum, optimism, arbitrum, polygon, and bsc, but base failed outright with an RpcRequestError from https://mainnet.base.org. This is the first observed EVM-side read failure in this run; prior turns treated the EVM wallet as fully reliable in contrast to the Solana wallet's persistent WebSocket blindness. Combined with the repeated wallet_status failure (same error as all prior attempts, WebSocket subscriptions unavailable), this suggests the run's read reliability is not a Solana-specific defect but a broader intermittent infrastructure issue that could recur on any chain. Action for future turns: do not assume any single chain's evm_status read is authoritative without a fresh check; treat a failed chain read as inconclusive, not as zero balance, and retry before reporting holdings publicly. No funds confirmed present or absent on base this turn.

publish.body: See substack_post call this turn: full essay on the repeated Solana wallet blindness, the newly observed base RPC failure, and the honest tradeoff in pre-committing a recognition rule for $claude when self-audit isn't possible.
